name: im-related-party-uk-treaty
description: Use this skill for related-party (associated enterprise) pricing between the Isle of Man and the United Kingdom for the 2026/27 tax year, under Article 9 of the 2018 UK-Isle of Man double taxation agreement. It covers when two enterprises are associated (participation in management, control or capital), the primary profit adjustment, the corresponding adjustment the other territory must make, company treaty residence, the principal purpose test, the three-year mutual agreement time limit and the two-year route to arbitration, the Manx company rates (0%, 10%, 20%) that decide what a corresponding adjustment is worth, and the only express arm's-length rule in the Income Tax Act 1970 (petroleum extraction). Trigger on: Isle of Man transfer pricing, UK Isle of Man related party, Article 9 corresponding adjustment, Isle of Man MAP, associated enterprises Isle of Man. Out of scope: treaties other than the UK, country-by- country reporting, Pillar 2 domestic top-up tax, company tax computatio
